19181.text: Slightly behind pace with about a fifth counted. Bohannan trails the 2024 House result and the 2022 House result. Warren is the biggest vote source in the district and the biggest drag.

outlook.text: Bohannan trails by about 1,700 votes with 13% counted, but the model projects D+3.7 and the neutral verdict stands. Des Moines is fully in and Jackson and Mahaska are beating pace. The big remaining sources are Johnson and Scott, with nothing counted in either. Johnson has a 73.8% win pace and should help. Scott needs 52.1%. Warren is the main drag.
